_comment: Price table for api/jd-rate.php (the reveal payload) and scripts/jd-spend.php.
All figures are USD per MILLION tokens.
Keys are jd_generations.model_version — the exact provider wire string that
jd-generate.php sent (the pool's api_model), so a model swap in
api/jd-config.php only needs a matching key added here.
Field meanings, normalised across all four providers by api/jd-usage.php:
output      output tokens (for OpenAI this INCLUDES reasoning tokens,
because completion_tokens already counts them; for Google it
cache_write Anthropic 5-minute cache writes; 0 for the others (OpenAI and
Moonshot have no such charge; Google implicit caching likewise)
cache_read  Anthropic cache hits / OpenAI cached input tokens / Moonshot
VERIFY BEFORE TRUSTING A LARGE NUMBER: providers change prices. Re-check the
source URLs below and update _fetched when you do.

_notes.claude-sonnet-5: Introductory $2/$10 runs through 2026-08-31; standard $3/$15 starts 2026-09-01. Update this entry if you switch the pair to Sonnet 5 after that date.
_notes.gpt-5.4: Prices shown are the <272K context tier.
_notes.gpt-5.5: Prices shown are the <272K context tier.
_notes.kimi-k3: Moonshot context caching is automatic — no write charge; hits bill at the cache_read rate.
_notes.gemini-3.1-pro-preview: $2/$12 is the <200K-context tier (our prompts are tiny). DISCREPANCY: one aggregator (costgoat) claims the *preview* id bills at $1/$6 — unresolvable from here; check the actual bill and correct. The 0.20 cache_read is an UNVERIFIED estimate (10% of input, the usual implicit-cache ratio), not a sourced figure.
